meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 构建或修改网页/终端界面后,Claude 会先截图或捕获终端画面,与参考图做像素对比,再派两个独立检查者分别审查设计系统是否符合规范和视觉/CJK 文字是否正常,最后给出“通过/不通过”的明确结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了任何界面,或提出“页面/组件/终端界面看起来是否正确”这类问题时会接管;也适用于提到视觉检查、像素对比、界面错乱等关键词时。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页,帮我检查它和设计稿是否一致
say.note: Claude 会截图对比并跑两个审查,给出结论。

say.text: 这个终端界面的边框对齐有点问题,请做一次视觉QA
say.note: 它会捕获终端画面并检查宽度与对齐。

say.text: 帮我看看这个网页在窄屏下CJK文字会不会截断
say.note: 触发响应式和CJK文字检查。

howto.what_en: After building or changing a web/TUI, Claude captures screenshots or terminal output, pixel-diffs them vs a reference, runs two read-only review passes (design-system, visual/CJK), then gives a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: It activates when you build or modify any UI, or ask whether a page/component/TUI looks right; also on mentions of visual QA, pixel diff, or broken layout.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page. Check it against the design mock.
say_en.note: Claude captures, diffs, and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: The TUI border alignment looks off—run a visual QA on it.
say_en.note: It captures the terminal and checks width and alignment.

say_en.text: Check whether CJK text clips on this page at narrow widths.
say_en.note: Triggers responsive and CJK text checks.
